releaseNotes: Stability round: live channels reconnect instead of closing on a source hiccup; a paused movie stays paused during auto-recovery; finishing an episode while the app is in the background now advances to the next episode instead of replaying; search results open live channels correctly on M3U playlists; D-pad DOWN works on the last partial row of a grid; login keeps what you typed if a keyboard is attached. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
